title: Cobble Gang
description: This is a small white-listed server running on a custom modpack. The primary goal for the modpack was Cobblemon with its essential add-ons and vanilla friendly mods to liven up and enhance the regular gameplay.
body: This server is a non pay to win white-listed SMP server. The server is new and began as a way for a small group of friends to play minecraft and pokemon together. We are actively recruiting for our community. The custom modpack we created focused on overhauling world generation, enhancing vanilla gameplay, and creating a richer cobblemon experience.
